---
title: Setup
---

The whole workshop runs on [Posit Assistant](https://assistant.posit.co/docs/getting-started/),
which ships in Positron, in RStudio, and as a terminal program. There are **no
API keys to create or paste** — you sign in once with Posit AI Pass.

## 1. Required — an editor and the project

- R 4.4 or later.
- **Either** [Positron](https://positron.posit.co) (recommended — the assistant
  can see your live session) **or** a recent RStudio. Both are fully supported
  for every hands-on exercise; pick the one you already use.
- Clone the workshop repository, open the project, and run `_setup.R`.

## 2. Required — sign in to Posit AI Pass

- Open the assistant pane and sign in. Details will be circulated before the
  meeting, along with whatever access Posit provides for attendees.
- Verify with `_exercises/01_setup-check/01_assistant.md`. There is no setup
  time in the session itself, so please do this before the day.
- If you already have an Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini key you prefer to use,
  Posit Assistant takes a bring-your-own-key provider instead. Either path works.

## 3. Optional — the `pa` terminal program

- Only needed if you want to follow along during the tier 3 demonstration.
- Verify with `_exercises/01_setup-check/02_agent.sh`.
- Claude Code works equally well here if that is what you already have.

## 4. Optional — Ollama

- For the closing local-model segment. Pull a small model **before** you travel;
  the download is too large for meeting wifi.

::: {.callout-tip}
## If setup fails
Come anyway. A Posit Cloud workspace with the project pre-built will be
available as a fallback, and the tier 3 material is watched rather than typed.
:::
